target.title: fix(session-memory): contain leaked role markers
target.body:
Related: #69943

Supersedes #97034.

Original reproduction and narrow sanitizer proposal by @SunnyShu0925 in #97034. Their authored commit is preserved as the first patch in this replacement stack, followed by @vincentkoc's formatting patch and the maintainer-reviewed containment refinement.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where a model/provider response containing a standalone `user`, `assistant`, or `system` line could be copied into durable session memory and later re-injected into a new session as active-looking chat-template framing. That could reinforce malformed output across later `/new` or `/reset` sessions.

The existing sanitizer covers special tokens, tool/function blocks, XML role tags, media placeholders, and trailing `NO_REPLY`, but did not safely contain plain role-only lines without deleting legitimate prose or code.

## Why This Change Was Made

The fix belongs at the session-memory transcript projection boundary rather than global model-output normalization. Canonical assistant history keeps the provider's finalized bytes, while assistant messages containing role-shaped standalone lines are rendered as one quoted Markdown container before persistence.

This preserves legitimate prose, fenced and indented code, lists, blockquotes, inline code, whitespace, and incomplete fences. Detection covers case variants, optional colons, CRLF, bare CR/LF, and Unicode line separators. User-authored content is unchanged.

The replay is based on the leased green `main` commit `aae1189d90f15a2a1b9cd96fbd629c8d60d1ae04` and preserves its reset-transcript recovery and delivery-mirror duplicate suppression. Display bytes stay lossless while mirror comparisons and slash-command omission use canonical boundary-trimmed text.

## User Impact

New session-memory files no longer expose assistant-origin role markers as standalone framing in saved memory or next-session startup context. Legitimate role-word prose and code remain readable, and canonical session history is not destructively normalized.

This is the bounded prevention portion of #69943. Recovery or quarantine of memory files that were already poisoned remains a separate migration/product decision in the canonical issue.

## Evidence

Ancestry and scope:

- Merge base is the leased green `main` SHA `aae1189d90f15a2a1b9cd96fbd629c8d60d1ae04` ([CI 28507984536](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28507984536)).
- Replacement head is `61af3db9746a2813a4fbf8026807f73222a4bd53`.
- Exactly three replayed commits and three changed files: `src/hooks/bundled/session-memory/transcript.ts`, `transcript.test.ts`, and `handler.test.ts`.
- Sunny's and Vincent's replayed patch IDs exactly match #97034; the canonical patch adds only leased-base conflict integration and accepted review fixes in the same owner boundary.

Exact-tree focused proof:

```console
OPENCLAW_HEAVY_CHECK_LOCK_SCOPE=worktree node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  src/hooks/bundled/session-memory/transcript.test.ts \
  src/hooks/bundled/session-memory/handler.test.ts

Test Files  2 passed (2)
Tests       41 passed (41)
```

Also passed:

- `oxfmt --check` and `oxlint` for all three changed files.
- `git diff --check`.
- `node scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.mjs --check`.
- Fresh exact-tree autoreview with `gpt-5.6-sol` at `xhigh`: zero findings, patch correct (0.97 confidence).
- Exact-head hosted [CI 28510853685](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28510853685) and [CodeQL 28510853703](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28510853703): passed.

The realistic integration test writes session JSONL, runs the real session-memory hook, reads the persisted Markdown, and passes it through `buildSessionStartupContextPrelude`. It proves transcript → saved memory → next-session context while retaining legitimate prose/code and removing standalone assistant-origin role framing.

Prior behavior proof on reviewed candidate #97034:

- Azure Crabbox `check:changed`: passed, run `run_7cb68c206a8e`, lease `cbx_74df910223ed` (`Standard_D32ds_v6`).
- Blacksmith Testbox touched hook shard: 48/48 passed, `tbx_01kweejk5bvkx893dw5c17da7z` ([run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28506053790)).
- Real Gateway/WebChat/`/reset` E2E with persisted-memory and next-session readback: 1/1 passed, `tbx_01kweh4zcxzbjpynx9w4383p9x` ([run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28508650545)).
